title: Drift Away Main Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Drift Away 4 was completely remodeled top to bottom in 2017 and may very well become your new favorite vacation home!
description_expanded: Description* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.117 SAVANNAH STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN , 4 TWINS - sleeps 8Prime Seaside Location Steps from the BeachWelcome to Drift Away Main, a beautifully updated lock-off beach home in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Perfectly positioned just one minute from private beach access and a five-minute walk to Seaside’s Central Square, this home places you within easy reach of the beach, shops, restaurants, and iconic Seaside charm. Recently renovated from top to bottom, Drift Away Main blends fresh coastal style with playful retro touches for a relaxed and memorable stay.Expansive Screened Porch & Outdoor LivingGuests are welcomed by a large wrap-around screened-in porch that immediately sets the tone for easy beach living. Multiple outdoor seating areas invite you to spread out and relax—from classic rocking chairs ideal for morning coffee, to a shaded dining area for four with overhead fan and lighting, to a comfortable lounge setup with a sofa and club chairs. This generously furnished porch creates an effortless indoor-outdoor flow and makes the home feel wonderfully expansive.Open-Concept Living, Dining & KitchenInside, the main level features a bright open floor plan connecting the living, dining, and kitchen spaces. The living room is outfitted with plush sofas, accent chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights or family game time. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six, with additional bar seating for three at the kitchen counter. The fully renovated kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances and a fun, retro-inspired green refrigerator, adding personality and beachy charm to the heart of the home.Comfortable Bedrooms & Updated BathroomsDrift Away Main offers four well-appointed bedrooms designed for comfort and flexibility. On the first floor, the front queen bedroom shares a fully renovated hall bathroom featuring a single vanity, a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, and direct access to an enclosed outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Also downstairs, a twin bedroom is tucked just off the dining area.Upstairs, the third bedroom features a spacious king bed, ample storage, and its own flat-screen smart TV. The adjacent fourth bedroom includes two twin beds, also with flat-screen TVs. These upstairs bedrooms share a renovated full hall bathroom with a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, completing the thoughtfully updated layout.A Relaxed Coastal Retreat in Seaside, FloridaWith its unbeatable location, stylish renovations, and inviting indoor-outdoor spaces, Drift Away Main is an ideal choice for families or groups seeking a laid-back Seaside vacation. Just steps from the beach and moments from everything that makes Seaside special, this home offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm.*All Drift Away units and the Hide Away cottage share one washer/dryer that is located under the stairwell at Hide Away. The driveway can be shared as well with Drift Away Suite Drift Away Suite and Hide Away units if occupied.Need more room, you can rent the main home combination Drift Away to sleep 12 in all. * 5-night minimum Spring, Fall, Winter. (Not Available for Spring Break, Summer or Fall Break) Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,378 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion, the largest stretch of private beach on 30A176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach access, plus a 5-minute walk to Seaside Central Square with over 35 shops and restaurantsNew Smart TVs (Roku-enabled) and enhanced Wi-Fi system installed for seamless streaming and connectivityPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeWasher & Dryer (Shared) – Located under the Hide Away unit, outside the homeFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote included with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homesGolf cart policy – A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners unless approved for special circumstances or medical needs with a permitNo pets allowed
